invariants.rationale: The method returns either 'fileId' or BulkInsertPartitioner.super.getFileIdPfx(partitionId), both of which are expected to be non-null.
If 'fileId' is non-null, result is exactly 'fileId'; otherwise, result is the delegated value from the superclass.
If fileId is null, result cannot equal fileId; otherwise, they are equal.
It is likely that fileId or the superclass method returns a non-empty string as a file id prefix.
It is reasonable to expect that partitionId is non-negative as a partition index.
